span.p:
Distribution makes your work effectively GPL.
Use GPL-3.0 or rework the dependency.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Even hosted/SaaS use triggers source-sharing.
Use AGPL-3.0 or replace the dependency.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Weak copyleft is file/library-scoped —
you may pick a permissive license for YOUR code,
but keep the dependency's files under its license.

span.p:
Is it a library
meant to be linked?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
LGPL-3.0 or MPL-2.0
copyleft on the library, linkable from closed code
